'''Ossiathora''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Ossiathora system/Legends|Ossiathora system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Deminol system/Legends|Deminol]] and [[Kassido system/Legends|Kassido systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ossiathora was the origin point of [[Ossiathoran noodles]]<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ossiathoran noodles]]|system=[[Ossiathora system/Legends|Ossiathora system]] and Ossiathora itself|legends=1}}</ref> and was controlled by [[House Kassido]], a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Ancient Houses|house]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kassido]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ossiathora was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
